verdicts.why: In The Punisher S1#10 Mahoney interrogates Russo about Wilson and his ties to Castle, and Russo walks out. They meet well before the S2#3 stage.
In The Punisher S1#3 Russo brings Hoyle the rent check for his group and the two drink at Castle's grave on his birthday. Their friendship is on screen long before the S1#13 stage.
In The Punisher S2#13 the dying Russo calls Hoyle and asks not to die alone. Hoyle tells Castle where he is instead, and Castle kills him.
In The Punisher S2#13 Russo attacks Madani after finding Dumont hurt, and she shoots him three times. Those wounds leave him dying.
In The Punisher S2#2 Russo, claiming amnesia, works with his therapist Dumont to piece his memories together. Their tie starts here, before the S2#6 stage.
In The Punisher S2#12 Russo gets fake passports so he and Dumont can start a new life, then finds her badly hurt after Madani pushes her out of the window. Their plans end there.
In The Punisher S1#12 Rawlins keeps torturing Castle and tries to cut out his eye, Russo helps Castle get free, and Castle kills Rawlins. That is a clear betrayal with no stage.
In Daredevil S2#2 Tower and Reyes meet Foggy and Karen at the precinct over Grotto and try to strong-arm Foggy, and the wire deal turns out to be bait for the Punisher. The connection starts here.
In Daredevil S3#12 Mahoney pulls Tower over so Foggy can offer to quit the race. Tower hears Nadeem's testimony and convenes a grand jury, turning the rivalry into cooperation.
Tower's DD S2#2 precinct meeting is with Foggy and Karen while Matt recovers, and Tower is not in S2#6. Tower first faces Matt at Castle's trial in S2#7.
Reyes is killed in Daredevil S2#10. In Luke Cage S1#11 Tower is simply the new DA, and nothing passes between him and Reyes there.
In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15 Morse sabotages the Playground, steals the toolbox from Coulson's office, and Gonzales' agents take the base. That clear betrayal has no stage.
In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20, after Sokovia, Morse defends Coulson to Weaver and the factions merge with Coulson as director. That reconciliation has no stage.
In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13 Coulson offers Morse and Hunter an EMP escape from Interpol. They refuse and let themselves be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D., ending their time there.

In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#6 May attacks Morse as a readiness test, takes her on the hunt for Ward, and reveals she scouted her at the Academy. This adds a real event between them after the S2#15 fight.
In Luke Cage S2#4 Bobby tells Luke he is a donor match for his sick daughter and is moving to San Diego. They reminisce about Pop and hug before he leaves Harlem.
In The Punisher S2#8 Mahoney corners Castle in an alley, and Hoyle fires a shot near his head and makes him drop his gun. The S2#13 stage refers back to this meeting, which has no stage of its own.
In The Punisher S2#13 Mahoney tells Madani he will not target her any more and offers back her badge and gun. At the church he reluctantly accepts the account of Russo's death that leaves Castle out.

In Daredevil S2#1 Mahoney only works the scene of an unknown shooter. He first meets Castle in S2#4, when Daredevil leaves Castle for him to arrest, and in Punisher S2#8 Mahoney recalls that arrest as their last encounter.
In Daredevil S3#13 Mahoney storms Fisk's suite, arrests him and Vanessa, and refuses Fisk a goodbye, asking whether Nadeem got one with his wife.
Clemons is dead by Daredevil S2#2 and is only quoted there by Mahoney ('mentioned' in his appearances). A remembered piece of advice is not an event between the two.

Beth and Frank share one night and a breakfast, and he comes back the next night when she is shot. They never meet on screen again. A brief fling doesn't make partners, and the stage's own text and card lines already describe a friend.
In Daredevil: Born Again S1#9 Cashman and Blake meet the City Council together and press them to back Safer Streets. They work side by side on Fisk's staff well before the S2#7 stage.

In Born Again S2#5 Blake believes Cashman is driving him out to be killed over BB's leaks, but they are going to bury Savva's body. Blake is under Cashman's supervision before Cashman kills him in S2#7.
In Born Again S2#6 Cashman encourages Glenn to imitate Muse's actions, after praising her killing of Muse as brave at Vanessa's funeral reception. That adds to their tie after the S1#2 stage.

The current card lines are plural ('Their mistress, who calls them', 'Her champions') and describe a group, not the Bride. In Iron Fist S1#6 the Bride is one of the Hand fighters Gao leads Danny to at the Da Jue Zhan.

In Jessica Jones S3#6 Brianna comes back to Malcolm and has a single sexual encounter with him, which she later calls forced, and then leaves town until S3#10. A brief fling doesn't make partners, and they become a couple only in S3#10.

In Born Again S2#2 Poindexter kills two AVTF officers at the hospital as part of his own war on the task force. He has no contact with Cherry, who is recovering and never interacts with him there, so nothing passes between them and they are not allies.
In Daredevil S3#6 Poindexter, dressed as Daredevil, throws a billy club at Foggy at the Bulletin, and later subdues him when Foggy punches him. Their connection starts here, not in Born Again.
In Daredevil S3#6 Poindexter knocks the gun from Karen's hand, raises it to her head, then shoots Evans dead in front of her. This comes before the S3#10 church attack.
In Born Again S1#1, after shooting Foggy, Bullseye greets Karen inside Josie's and points his gun at her until Daredevil tackles him.
In Born Again S2#6 Karen aims at the restrained Poindexter's forehead to avenge Foggy, and Murdock stops her.
In Daredevil S3#2 Poindexter, part of Fisk's FBI escort, saves Fisk when the Albanians ambush the convoy, and in S3#4 Fisk covers for his executions. This is before Fisk recruits him in S3#6.
In Born Again S2#4 Poindexter attacks the Fisks at Fogwell's Gym and a shard from his throw hits Vanessa. Daredevil stops Fisk from killing him. That clash has no stage.

In Daredevil S3#2 Nadeem and Poindexter escort Fisk together, and Nadeem later says Poindexter saved his life in that ambush and raises a legal fund for him. Their friendship starts here, before S3#8.
In Daredevil S3#13 Poindexter shoots Hattley in the gut during the wedding attack, pulls the trigger again on an empty gun, and throws it at her head.

In Daredevil S3#12 Poindexter brings the painting to the penthouse and introduces himself to Vanessa as the new Wesley. Vanessa talks Fisk into having Nadeem killed, and they send Poindexter, who kills him.

In Daredevil S3#13 Poindexter crashes the wedding and throws a microphone, then a paperweight, at Vanessa, and Daredevil deflects both before Fisk breaks his back. This is well before the Born Again stages.
